title: Practice: Five to a hundred in every case

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: There are ten decades in a century.
exercises.why: After all other numerals (**пять**, **шесть**, **семь**, etc.) as well as after all compound numbers with 5, 6, 7, etc. as last word, the noun is in the genitive plural: *5 уроков, 35 уроков; 10 страниц, 40 страниц; 11 слов, 111 слов.* — DLI, Lesson 71.
